settings.heading: DELIVERY & PICKUP
settings.subtitle: YOUR SET IS GETTING READY TO ENTER YOUR SCENE ✦
settings.introduction: Every NailScene order goes through our preparation process before it's ready for pickup or delivery. Choose the option that works best for you at checkout.
settings.note_body: Confirm your delivery address, contact number, and selected delivery method before completing your order.

settings.title: PROCESSING TIME
settings.description: Orders are typically processed within 24 hours.

settings.title: FREE PICKUP
settings.description: Prefer to collect your order? Select Pickup at checkout and follow the instructions provided to arrange collection.

settings.title: STANDARD NEXT-DAY DELIVERY
settings.description:
Get your NailScene order delivered by Trexity for $7 in eligible delivery areas. Delivery is scheduled according to Trexity's next-day service availability and order preparation times.

SECURE DELIVERY // PIN VERIFICATION ✦

You'll receive a 4-digit delivery PIN to provide to your Trexity courier in person before collecting your package.

Please ensure someone is available to receive your order, as packages cannot be collected without a PIN.

settings.title: SAME-DAY DELIVERY
settings.description:
Need your nails today? Trexity same-day delivery is available for eligible orders and delivery locations. The delivery fee will be shown at checkout.

SECURE DELIVERY // PIN VERIFICATION ✦

You'll receive a 4-digit delivery PIN to present to your Trexity courier in person before collecting your package.

Please ensure someone is available to receive your order.
